subject: NovaPix POC — finalize evaluation plan, exec readout & contract path
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novapix.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novapix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPix POC — proposed evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great meeting today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to get the POC started so we can drive to an exec decision: 

Goal (what success looks like)
- Integration of a 50k-record sample dataset into a sandbox endpoint with privacy controls in place.
- End‑to‑end latency < 400ms p50 for 1k tokens and throughput support for 8 concurrent requests.
- Accuracy benchmark: F1 >= 0.78 on your labeled holdout set for the three core intents we discussed.
- Operational checks: KV cache hit > 30% for repeated prompts; logs accessible for audit.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria and access to sample data. (Attachment: novapix-poc-success-criteria.xlsx)
- Weeks 1–3: environment setup, ingestion, and validation (engineering + SRE support).
- Week 4: run evaluation suite, collect metrics, compile readout deck.
- Week 5: exec readout and go/no‑go decision.

Owners
- Redwood POC lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — infra and SRE coordination
- Redwood engineer: to be assigned (I’ll propose a lead once we confirm dataset needs)
- NovaPix lead: Alex Green / Priya Sharma — dataset and business success criteria

Next steps
1) Please confirm the success criteria attached or suggest edits (esp. the F1 target).
2) Provide a test dataset slice and the contact for your security review.
3) Let me know two 30‑minute windows next week for a technical kickoff.

Attachments: novapix-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

Thanks — I’ll line up engineers once you confirm dataset access.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Alex Green <alex.green@novapix.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novapix.com>, Caleb Ortiz <caleb.ortiz@novapix.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPix POC — proposed evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few notes from our side after reviewing the success criteria: 
- The F1 target looks reasonable for intents 1 & 2 but is aggressive for intent 3; can we add relaxed thresholds per intent (we can share labeled counts).
- We need a short demo of the sample ingestion flow and any pre-processing you do (tokenization / normalization). Can Redwood ingest csv/ndjson and map custom fields?
- Procurement is asking for a short SOW + ballpark quote before the exec readout — they want to understand the one‑time onboarding and the expected monthly inference costs. Attaching our procurement intake form.

Tentative exec availability: week of Oct 4; prefer Oct 6 morning PT if that works for you. 

I’ve attached a small sample (anonymized) and the procurement form.

Attachments: novapix-poc-scope.pdf (pdf, 18KB), novapix-sample-0001.ndjson (data sample, 2MB)

Alex Green
Director, Product — NovaPix
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPix POC — internal: resourcing + timeline impact

Tessa / team —

Quick internal note after reviewing the sample Alex shared: ingestion will require a light transformation step (field mapping + dedupe) and a short privacy review — expect an extra week for that work. Proposed internal plan: 
- POC engineer: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com) — onboarding & ingestion pipeline
- SRE lead: Marcus Lin — test harness & load validation
- Customer success for readout + adoption checks: Monica Patel

Updated timeline (recommended)
- Week 0: access + field mapping (Novapix to confirm)
- Weeks 1–4: environment setup + ingestion + validation (Karthik lead)
- Week 5: evaluation runs and metrics collection (Marcus lead)
- Week 6: internal prep and exec readout (10–15 minute demo + metric review)

We should also prepare a short SOW and a ballpark cost model before the exec meeting — procurement wants that. I’ll draft a one‑page statement of work and share by Oct 1.

Action items assigned:
- Karthik: sketch ingestion plan and infra estimate (due Oct 1)
- Marcus: prepare load test plan and expected p50/p90 targets (due Oct 2)
- Monica: draft success/readout deck template and attendee list (due Oct 2)

—Ben
From: Alex Green <alex.green@novapix.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novapix.com>, Caleb Ortiz <caleb.ortiz@novapix.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novapix.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPix POC — proposed evaluation plan & next steps

Tessa / Ben —

Thanks for the updates and the proposed owners. Quick confirmations from our side: 
- Execs attending the readout: Priya Sharma (CTO), Caleb Ortiz (Head of Data).
- Procurement will need a draft SOW and redlineable SLA; procurement@novapix.com is the contact for expedited review.
- Proposed exec readout slot: Tue, Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT — this works for the execs listed.

We’ve uploaded an anonymized 50k sample to the drive link you shared earlier and attached our procurement form. Please send the SOW & ballpark pricing before EOD Oct 3 if possible so procurement can start triage.

Attachments: novapix-procurement-form.pdf (pdf, 24KB)

Alex
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novapix.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novapix.com>, Caleb Ortiz <caleb.ortiz@novapix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPix POC — finalize evaluation plan, exec readout & contract path

Alex / Priya / Caleb —

Confirmed — we’ll run the exec readout Tue, Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novapix-exec-readout-20261006). Thank you for moving quickly on the sample and procurement form. 

What Redwood will deliver by EOD Oct 3
- Draft SOW (redwood-draft-sow.docx) with scope & timeline
- Draft SLA (redwood-draft-sla.pdf) for procurement to redline
- Ballpark cost model (monthly inference + one‑time onboarding)

What we need from NovaPix before Oct 6 readout
- Finalized success criteria (if you have per-intent thresholds, add to the spreadsheet)
- Any security/classification tags we need to apply to the sample data for the audit
- Procurement contact confirmation (procurement@novapix.com)

Readout format (15–20 minutes total)
- 10 minute demo + live metrics (Karthik + Marcus)
- 5–10 minute business impact summary & Q/A (Tessa + Alex)

Go/no‑go decision path
- Exec readout on Oct 6 — NovaPix execs provide preliminary go/no‑go signal.
- Procurement will triage the SOW/SLA during Oct 6–13.
- Formal contract execution target: Oct 16 (assuming standard redlines).

Internal callouts (Ben / Karthik / Marcus / Monica) — please have the demo and readout deck ready by Oct 5 COB.

Attachments: redwood-draft-sow.docx (docx, 12KB), redwood-draft-sla.pdf (pdf, 9KB)

Looking forward — see you on the 6th.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
